title: Three protein extraction methods for mass spectrometry proteomics of fresh frozen mouse tissue
protocol: Euthanize mice and dissect necessary tissue.
Flash freeze tissue in liquid nitrogen.
Store fresh frozen tissue at -80°C.
Weigh fresh frozen tissue on an analytical balance and note tissue wet weight.
Add 100 μl of extraction buffer 1 to the fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7 ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind tissue using a motorized tissue grinder vigorously for 3 minutes.
Add an additional 100 μl of extraction buffer 1 and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100 μl per 5 mg of tissue wet weight).
Repeat tissue grinding until large tissue chunks cannot be observed.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE.
Sonicate suspension in Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator with the following program: Time 5 min, constant pulse for 30 s with peak watt of 130 W and a pause of 30 s between each pulse.
Centrifuge tissue suspension at 18,000g for 10 minutes.
Transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Take an aliquot of tissue lysate for quantification using Pierce BCA protein assay kit.
For every 10 μl of tissue lysate, add 500 μl of urea buffer to dilute protein lysate.
Load 500 μl of diluted tissue lysate onto a Vivacon 500 filter unit.
Centrifuge at 14,000g for 15 minutes. Discard flow-through.
Repeat loading and centrifugation for 500 μl volumes of tissue lysate onto the same filter unit.
Add 200 μl of urea buffer. Centrifuge at 14,000g for 15 minutes. Discard flow-through. Perform step twice.
Add 100 μl of 100mM DTT in urea buffer. Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14,000g for 15 minutes. Discard flow-through.
Add 100 μl of 100mM IAA in urea buffer. Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes in the dark.
Centrifuge at 14,000g for 15 minutes. Discard flow-through.
Add 200 μl of urea buffer. Centrifuge at 14,000g for 15 minutes. Discard flow-through.
Add trypsin to protein in a ratio of 1:20.
Add 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate solution to final volume of 200 μl.
Mix filter unit at 600 rpm for 1 min.
Incubate at 37°C for 14-18 hours.
Transfer filter unit to a clean collection tube.
Centrifuge at 14,000g for 20 minutes to elute peptides.
Add 100 μl of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate solution.
Centrifuge at 14,000g for 20 minutes to elute peptides.
Pool eluted peptides solution and add formic acid to final concentration of 1% v/v.
Proceed with solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns following manufacturer’s instructions.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation.
Store peptide pellets at -20°C.
Inject and load 100 μl of peptides onto SCX column with the specified gradient.
Collect five SCX fractions from 3 to 51 min and a sixth fraction from 51 to 75 min.
Proceed with solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns following manufacturer’s instructions for each SCX fraction.
Concentrate peptide fractions by vacuum centrifugation.
Store peptide pellets at -20°C.
Resuspend peptides to 0.5 μg/μl concentration in 0.1% formic acid in water.
Prepare liquid chromatograph with solvent A: 0.1% formic acid in water and solvent B: 0.1% formic acid, 80% acetonitrile in water.
Load 2 μl of peptides onto trap column (Acclaim PepMap C18 column) with flow rate of 3 μl/min.
Perform reverse phase separation using an Easy-Spray HPLC column, 75 µm x 500 mm.
Record precursor ion spectra from 400-1500 m/z with 60,000 m/z Orbitrap resolution.
Select top 20 precursor ions for fragmentation.
Exclude isotopes with charge 1 and ≥5.
Set isolation window to 0.7 Th and intensity threshold to 1.6 x10^5.
Record fragment ions from 200-2000 m/z.
Use 30,000 m/z resolution.
Set automatic gain control target to 2 x10^5 ions.
Limit maximum injection time to 50 ms.
Add 100 μl of extraction buffer 2 to the fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7 ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind tissue using a motorized tissue grinder vigorously for 3 minutes.
Add an additional 100 μl of extraction buffer 2 to the tissue and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100 μl extraction buffer per 5 mg of tissue wet weight).
Repeat tissue grinding until large tissue chunks cannot be observed.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE, with each milliTUBE holding up to 1 ml of tissue suspension.
Sonicate suspension in Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator for 6 min using the following program: 200 cycles per burst with peak watt of 175 W and 10% duty factor.
Heat suspension at 95°C for 1 hour.
Repeat step to sonicate suspension.
Centrifuge tissue suspension at 18,000 g for 10 min to clear large particulates.
Transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Take an aliquot of tissue lysate for quantification using Pierce BCA protein assay kit, following manufacturer’s instructions.
Adjust protein concentration of tissue lysate to 1 μg/μl based on BCA assay results.
Add 11 μl of 100 mM DTT in extraction buffer 2 to the tissue lysate. Incubate at 56°C for 1 hour.
Leave solution to cool to room temperature before adding 12 μl of 550 mM IAA in extraction buffer 2
Incubate the solution at room temperature for 30 minutes in the dark.
Add 13 μl of 100 mM DTT in extraction buffer 2 to the tissue lysate.
Incubate the mixture at 56°C for 30 minutes.
Allow the solution to cool to room temperature.
Centrifuge the cooled solution at 100g for 2 minutes to clear large particulates.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Add 20 μl of 12% phosphoric acid to the tissue lysate.
Add 2.8 ml of binding buffer to the tissue lysate.
Load 400 μl of the lysate mixture onto the S-trap mini column.
Centrifuge at 4,000g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Repeat loading remaining lysate in 400 μl portions until all is loaded.
Wash the S-Trap column by adding 400 μl of binding buffer.
Centrifuge at 4,000g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Perform this wash step three times.
Transfer the spin column to a fresh 2 ml tube.
Add trypsin at a 1:20 w/w concentration in 125 μl of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate to the spin column.
Lightly centrifuge the spin column to ensure it is wet.
Pipette any flow-through back into the spin column.
Gently tap the column to remove bubbles if present.
Cap the spin column and incubate at 37°C for 18 hours without shaking.
After incubation, add 80 μl of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate to the column.
Centrifuge at 1,000g for 30 seconds to elute peptides.
Add 80 μl of 80% acetonitrile with 0.2% formic acid to the column
Centrifuge at 1,000g for 30 seconds to elute peptides.
Repeat the centrifugation step once more.
Centrifuge the column at 4,000g for 30 seconds to elute all remaining peptides.
Pool the eluted peptide solutions.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation.
Store peptide pellets at -20°C.
Add 100 μl of extraction buffer 3 to fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7 ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind tissue using a motorized tissue grinder vigorously for 3 minutes.
Add an additional 100 μl of extraction buffer 3 to the tissue and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100 μl per 5 mg of tissue wet weight).
Repeat tissue grinding until large tissue chunks cannot be observed.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE, with each milliTUBE holding up to 1 ml of tissue suspension.
Sonicate the suspension in a Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator for 5 minutes using a constant pulse of 30 seconds at peak wattage of 130W and a pause of 30 seconds between pulses.
Centrifuge tissue suspension at 18,000g for 10 minutes to clear large particulates.
Transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Take an aliquot of tissue lysate for quantification using Pierce BCA protein assay kit, following manufacturer’s instructions.
Adjust protein concentration of tissue lysate to 1 μg/μl based on BCA assay results. Take 100 μl (100 μg) of protein for further steps.
Add 11 μl of 100 mM DTT in extraction buffer 2 to the tissue lysate. Incubate at 56°C for 1 hour.
Leave solution to cool to room temperature before adding 12 μl of 550 mM IAA in extraction buffer 2. Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes in the dark.
Add 13 μl of 100 mM DTT in extraction buffer 2 to the tissue lysate. Incubate at 56°C for 30 minutes.

Leave solution to cool to room temperature. Add 50 μl of 0.1 μg/μl of trypsin (Trypsin to Protein ratio 1:20) and dilute to a final volume of 1 ml with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate. Incubate at 37°C for 14-18 hours.
After trypsin incubation, add formic acid to final 1% v/v concentration. Proceed with solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns (Nest Group) following manufacturer’s instructions.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation. Store peptide pellets at -20°C.
